description: Lists a domain's MCP endpoints from the official MCP Registry with recorded handshake status, tool count and tool-list drift. Missing observations, observations older than the registry listing, or observations over seven days old can queue fresh remote checks. Use before connecting. For a go/no-go decision use preflight with action connect; for your own release use mcp_precheck.
